The '''Uzer Oasis''' is a small settlement found directly south of the ruins of the [[Ruins of Uzer]]. The oasis contains three homes and the [[Uzer Mastaba]], a ruined mastaba on a hill to the south.

Little history is known about the area, although it likely shares some history with the nearby ruins. Various rockslides, tropical trees, and oasis trees surround the oasis at the centre of the settlement. Various crates dot the area, but do not contain any items.

== Transportation ==

* {{Plink|Necklace of passage}} to the [[Eagle's Eyrie]] —  north-west of the oasis.
* {{Plink|Fairy ring|pic=Fairy ring (Construction) icon}} {{Fairycode|dlq}} — just west of the oasis, near the [[Desert lizard|desert lizards]].
* {{Plink|Nardah teleport}} — Nardah, south of the oasis.
* {{Plink|Desert amulet 2|txt=Desert amulets}} — Temple of Elidinis in Nardah.
* {{Plink|Pharaoh's sceptre}} — [[Jaleustrophos]] ([[Simon Templeton]]'s camp), decent south of the oasis.
* {{Plink|Construct. cape|txt=Construction cape}} — [[Pollnivneach]] house portal, far west of the oasis.

==Features==
The area is notable for containing three [[teak]] trees, two [[mahogany]] trees, and four [[clay rocks]]. Four buildings also exist in the oasis:

* [[Ali the Tea Seller]]'s house, a large three-story villa.
* [[Morgiana]]'s house, a two-story house containing a [[range]].
** After completing [[A Ruff Situation]], the rescue spot for Chihuahua can be found on the hill due north of Morgiana's house.
* [[Cassim]]'s house, a single-story home with a [[well]] out front.
* The [[Uzer Mastaba]], a large [[tomb]] to the south.

Despite the lack of "content" in the area, is possible that a future [[Quest points|quest]] will take place in the oasis, possibly related to [[Sailing]]. This is evidenced by the inaccessible trapdoor in Cassim's house, the unused dock to the east that opens into the currently-inaccessible [[Uzer Channel]], and dialogue with Ali the Tea Seller hinting at a quest that can't be started.

==Inhabitants==

=== Personalities ===

*{{Chatl|Ali the Tea Seller}}, a contradictory man who players cannot buy tea from.
*{{Chatl|Cassim}}, a [[Zamorak|Zamorakian]] mage who imports wine.
*{{Chatl|Elias White}} (only between completion of [[Defender of Varrock]] and completion of [[The Curse of Arrav]])
*{{Chatl|Morgiana}}, a retired [[Saradomin|Saradominist]] knight who watches for roaming bandits

=== Monsters ===
*[[Bird]] (x7)
*[[Billy Goat|Billy goat]] (x2)
*[[Desert Lizard|Desert lizard]] (x2)
*[[Golem guard]] (only before completing [[The Curse of Arrav]])
*[[Seagull]] (x4)
*[[Small Lizard|Small lizard]] (x2)
*[[Small scarab]] (x18)
*[[Snake]] (x4)

== Music ==

* In the area, the music will shuffle between [[Arabian 3]], [[Desert Voyage]], [[The Desert]], [[Egypt]], [[Scarab]], [[Sphinx (music track)|Sphinx]] and [[Sunburn]]. In the Mastaba, players unlock [[The Plundered Tomb]].

== Trivia ==

* There is a cooking pot over a fire behind Ali the Tea Seller's house, but it can't be used for [[Cooking]]. Trying to use raw food or a [[tinderbox]] on it will give a message saying "the fire already appears to be in use".
